'''Andy Klema'''<ref name="dt-19025">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19025 King of Dagocheese], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 20 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19025/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19025/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017021618/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19025/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''RexBanner7'''<ref name="gpn-2098">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=2098 Space Strong Light Side LSC], Game Players Network (RexBanner7, 9 May 2002), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) is a core member of [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. With [[Justin Desai]], [[Mike Gemme]], and [[Steve Baroni]], he was part of the New England group that formed around 2002.<ref name="hof">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], Players Committee</ref><ref name="gr">[https://garbagerollers.com/2024/02/02/community-spotlight-ktod-feb-2nd-2024/ Community Spotlight: KToD], Garbage Rollers (2 February 2024)</ref> Klema posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in September 2001 and one on [[Game Players Network]] in May 2002.
